title: Solar Cell Array Design Handbook, Volume I
lineage: Inspected the identified passage; retained file is a short paraphrased research note, not a full copy.

passages.note: Vanguard I launched on 17 March 1958 with six panels of 18 solar cells each. The handbook says the array provided less than one watt for more than six years; it reports approximately 10% cell efficiency at 28°C.
